finding: Neon introduction says A7 throughout, but song contains E7 in chorus and B7/E7 bridge; guitar spotlight correctly says chorus drops to E7.

evidence.source: Neon Laundromat stays on one chord, A7, the whole way through. A vamp like this lives on rhythm: tight, choppy strums at 96 beats per minute and a hook that dodges the beat.
evidence.translation: Neon Laundromat पूर्ण वेळ एकाच A7 कॉर्डवर राहते. असा पुनरावृत्त व्हॅम्प लयीवर जगतो: प्रतिमिनिट 96 ठेक्यांनी नेमके, तुटक स्ट्रम आणि मुख्य ठेका चुकवत जाणारी लक्षवेधी चाल.
evidence.context: Originals · Unit 4 · song orig-neon-laundromat “Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

evidence.source: Neon Laundromat is a Timbre Original: funk that sits on one chord, A7. Its hook slides from C to C sharp, the same rub your blues licks make, and its chorus drops to E7. The whole song is in Songs, under Originals.
evidence.translation: Neon Laundromat हे Timbre चे मौलिक गाणे: A7 या एकाच कॉर्डवरील फंक. लक्षवेधी चाल C वरून C शार्पकडे सरकते—तुमच्या ब्लूज लिक्ससारखाच ताण—आणि मुखडा E7 कडे उतरतो. पूर्ण गाणे गाणीमधील मौलिक गाणी विभागात आहे.
evidence.context: Guitar · Unit 12 · lesson gtr-12-spotlight “Song spotlight: Neon Laundromat” · step 1 (explain) · lesson card text

finding: G to G sharp can slide on string 3, but open B is on string 2; sliding into open B can mean melodic motion rather than a literal same-string slide.

evidence.source: Open B, D at fret 3, open E and back. Then G and G sharp on string 3, sliding into open B.

finding: A sharp at string 3 fret 3 is followed by open B on string 2; a literal same-string finger slide cannot end on that open string.

evidence.source: A sharp sits between A and B, at fret 3 on string 3. It slides up into open B, the bluesy lift that gives gospel its sound.
evidence.translation: A शार्प हा A आणि B यांच्या मध्ये, तार 3 वरील फ्रेट 3 वर आहे. तो वर मोकळ्या B कडे सरकतो; ब्लूजसारखी ही चढण गॉस्पेलचा बाज घडवते.
